title: finding-analyst.input.v1
description: What the finding-analyst subagent is handed. Its OUTPUT contract is finding.v1 itself (schemas/finding.v1.schema.json), so there is no second output schema to drift.

summary.description: The machine-computed numbers from `llens derive --summary` (summary.json). The agent interprets them; it never recomputes them.

register.description: The current version of every finding (`llens findings current`).
